reviews.text: Cercavo un contorno occhi a base di avocado che avesse buoni ingredienti e fosse sufficientemente idratante da poterlo utilizzare la sera. Questo ha una consistenza quasi "pomatosa" molto densa ma si spalma bene e non risulta troppo grasso sulla zona occhi. Idrata bene e si può abbondare a seconda che si voglia un effetto più o meno occlusivo. Non ha particolare odore e lo trovo delicato.
reviews.zh: 我想搵一款以牛油果為基礎嘅眼霜，成分要好，又要夠滋潤，可以晚上用。呢款質地幾乎似軟膏咁厚，但係好易推開，喺眼周位置都唔會太油。補水效果好好，你可以按照自己想要嘅封閉程度，多擦或者少擦。冇咩特別嘅味道，我覺得好溫和。

reviews.text: Para mi tía, que era su primer contorno le ha ido bastante bien, ya que es bastante suave
reviews.zh: 俾我阿姨用，因為呢個係佢第一次用眼霜，佢用得幾好，因為呢款好溫和。

reviews.text:
I was quite excited to try this eye cream, since l expected it to feel nourishing given the ingredients list & rich, dense texture, but unfortunately it doesn't. It's formulated with:
Shea Butter, Niacinamide, Avocado Oil, Sodium Hyaluronate, Cocoa Seed Extract, Allantoin, Acetyl Hexapeptide-8, Avocado Fruit Extract. It might be moisturizing for some, but it's not enough for dry skin.
reviews.zh:
我好期待試呢款眼霜，因為我以為佢睇落成分表同質地又厚又密，應該會好滋養，但係好可惜，佢並唔係咁。佢嘅配方包括：
乳木果脂、煙酰胺、牛油果油、透明質酸鈉、可可籽萃取、尿囊素、乙醯基六胜肽-8、牛油果果實萃取。對某啲人嚟講可能有保濕效果，但係對乾性皮膚嚟講唔夠。

reviews.text: j’ai le contour des yeux très sec ce produit est très hydratant et me permets de garder mon contour des yeux parfaitement hydraté
reviews.zh: 我嘅眼周好乾，呢款產品好滋潤，令我嘅眼周保持到好水潤。

reviews.text: Tengo el contorno bastante seco y esta crema con textura rica parecía adecuada pero no veo ningún cambio, en cuanto se absorbe la puel sigue bastante seca. Va bien debajo del maquillaje, no se cuartea
reviews.zh: 我眼周好乾，呢款質地豐富嘅面霜睇落好似啱，但係我冇見到任何改變，一吸收晒，皮膚仍然好乾。喺化妝底下都好好，唔會起裂紋。

reviews.text: I have to say, the name of this product describes it well: it really is like butter! It's very thick and feels rich on the skin. I liked how it felt and thought that this would be perfect for my very dry under eye skin, but unfortunately it wasn't. After a few days of using this, I noticed that the white little spots (little pieces of under eye fat I guess) had become more visible than normal. This has sometimes happened, when I've tried to use some face cream in the under eye area. I stopped using this and the white spots became less visible again. So unfortunately this product wasn't it for me, but I believe it could work great for others!
reviews.zh: 我必須講，呢款產品嘅名字好貼切：佢真係好似牛油咁！質地好厚，塗喺皮膚上好豐富。我好鍾意塗抹嘅感覺，以為佢對我眼周非常乾燥嘅皮膚會好啱，但係好可惜，佢唔係咁。用咗幾日之後，我留意到啲白色小粒（我諗係眼周嘅小脂肪粒）比平時更明顯。我以前喺眼周位置用面霜時，都試過呢種情況。我停咗用呢款，白色小粒又再變得唔咁明顯。所以好可惜，呢款唔啱我，不過我相信佢對其他人可能好好。

feels like butter

用咗5日之後，我覺得我嘅黑眼圈睇落好啲。
